name: AI Governance Framework Generator
description: Generates tailored AI governance frameworks for Australian businesses, aligned with the six AI6 practices in Australia's Voluntary AI Safety Standard (NAIC Guidance for AI Adoption). Profiles an organisation by industry, size and AI usage, then returns a structured, informational framework preview covering Accountability and Impact Assessment, with a link to the full six-practice framework. A structured starting point for Australian organisations shaping their AI policy and governance approach. Presents frameworks, not advice.
author: Kentron

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Begin generating an AI governance framework for an Australian business.

tools.name: submit_answers
tools.description: Submit the completed organisation profile for an AI governance framework session.

tools.name: get_framework
tools.description: Returns the free preview of a tailored AI governance framework, covering the first two of six AI6 practices.
